grains.RAW.BRANCHES: one row per fictional bank branch (city, format, risk tier)
grains.RAW.BRANCH_DAILY: one row per branch per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.CONTROL_DOCUMENTS: one row per branch (branch control document snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.failure_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(failed-transaction incident at the branch in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide incident-volume FORECAST; ATM downtime ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.INCIDENT_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic incident-handling SOPs (one per branch format and incident type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.BRANCH_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.BRANCH_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, branch, incident-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (branches, daily incidents, failed transactions by branch, failed-transaction risk, transaction events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TRANSACTIONS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_INCIDENT_ALERT logs new INCIDENT events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
